noAnnounce.linkRefused: Linking will be refused until a `trackers` entry is added

reject.title: Reject the selection?
reject.description: One reject request is sent for each proposal listed below. Nothing is applied, but a rejection cannot be taken back.
reject.summary: Only pending proposals are rejected; none is accepted.

group.title: Accept group {group}?
group.description: Accepts the group's primary proposal and, in native cross-seed mode only, the other verified torrents of the same group.
group.summaryNative: Native cross-seed mode: the primary (★) and one pending proposal per other verified torrent will be accepted.
group.summaryOther: Cross-seed mode {mode}: only the primary (★) is accepted.

force.title: Force the start of the partial?
force.description: The client will download the missing pieces. Each linked media file that shares one of those pieces is first replaced, in the links folder only, by an independent copy (reflink, otherwise a full copy that needs space): the library is never written. The start is refused when no copy is possible. This action cannot be undone. If a source changed since the verification, the proposal becomes outdated and the action is refused.
force.summary: Only a partial with missing annexes, already seeded paused, can be forced.

partial.title: Accept a partial pack?
partial.description: A partial pack is incomplete: some media of the torrent are not in the library. It is added paused and Necromanciarr can never start it.
partial.summary: A partial pack can never be forced.

choose.title: Choose a candidate
choose.description: The chosen torrent becomes the group's primary proposal; the others stay pending.
choose.empty: No candidate to choose: the conflict lists no torrent.

dedupe.caption: Proposed replacements
dedupe.empty: No replacement proposed. Compute the plan.

actions.acceptAndApplyOf: Accept and apply the replacement of {name}

confirm.bulkTitle: Apply {count} accepted replacement? | Apply {count} accepted replacements?
confirm.descriptionDry: Dry run: every check runs, no file is modified.
confirm.descriptionReal: Each listed torrent-side file is replaced by a link to the identical library file; the library is never written.
confirm.summaryDry: Dry run: nothing is created or replaced. Proposals are checked one by one, nothing is accepted.
confirm.summaryReal: Each torrent-side file is replaced by a link, one at a time, after a torrent client recheck when one is configured. The run stops at the first error.
confirm.summaryRealPending: This proposal is pending: it is accepted then applied. The torrent-side file is replaced by a link to the library.

applicable.needsClientRecheck: Not applicable without a torrent client: the method waits for its recheck

actions.acceptAndApplyOf: Accept and apply the repair of {name}

confirm.title: Apply this repair?
confirm.descriptionDry: Dry run: every check runs, no file is modified.
confirm.descriptionReal: The listed link is rebuilt to its new target; the library is never written.
confirm.summaryDry: Dry run: nothing is created or replaced. The proposal is checked without being accepted.
confirm.summaryReal: The link is rebuilt to the new target, after a torrent client recheck when one is configured.
confirm.summaryRealPending: This proposal is pending: it is accepted then applied. The link is rebuilt to the new target.

idHint.url: Identifier: the URL's scheme://host[:port], in lower case, without the default port (80 for http, 443 for https), credentials, path or query (a #2 suffix tells apart two instances at the same address).

form.description: The saved item fully replaces the previous one.

remove.title: Delete this item?
remove.hide: The item comes from cross-seed: it will be hidden, cross-seed is not changed.
remove.delete: The item and its override will be deleted from the database.
remove.revert: The cross-seed value of this element is restored and its override is removed from the database.
remove.orphan: The orphan override will be deleted from the database.

field.name: Name
field.tieBreakReadBytes: Bytes read to break a tie

help.announce: One URL per line; they contain the passkey.
help.crossSeedApiKey: API key of the cross-seed daemon; it replaces the one from cross-seed.
help.crossSeedUrl: Address of the daemon (http://cross-seed:2468), without credentials or query; it replaces the host and port from cross-seed.
help.fsProviderName: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. icue); this name is used in sftp://name/….
help.indexerUrl: Torznab feed address in clear, without any query (no ?apikey=) or proxy segment: the indexer key has its own field.
help.libraryApi: Library API URL (token included if any).
help.libraryToken: Bearer token sent to the library API; the LIBRARY_PROVIDER_TOKEN variable, when set, wins.
help.mounts: Each row links a folder of this server to its rclone location, for example /mnt/icue and icue:media. Only the rclone type needs it: an sftp volume is named with sftp://name/path.
help.prowlarr: Prowlarr native API URL, key included.
help.publicUrl: HTTPS address users reach, without a path (https://necromanciarr.example.com): it pins WebAuthn and the Secure cookie.
help.serviceUrl: Address in clear, without credentials or query: the keys, user and password have their own fields. Behind a keyed proxy, write {'{'}proxyKey{'}'} right after /proxy/ (http://host:7476/proxy/{'{'}proxyKey{'}'}/radarr) and enter the key in “Proxy key”.
help.sourceOrder: One source per line: provider, then torznab:name.

help.arrKind: The service to connect. After saving, “Add another service” lets you configure the other one.
help.arrUrl: Address of the service as Necromanciarr reaches it, for example from another container.
help.arrApiKey: API key shown in the service settings, General section.
help.clientUrl: Address of the qBittorrent web interface.
help.clientUsername: Leave empty if the web interface needs no login.
help.clientPassword: Web interface password; it is sealed in the database.
help.libraryRoots: One absolute path per line, as this process sees it.
help.linkDir: Folder where links are created, on the same filesystem as the library.
help.libraryApi: Address of your library provider API.
help.libraryToken: Token sent to the provider, if its API requires one.
help.trackerKey: Tracker name as the provider writes it.
help.trackerAnnounce: Tracker announce address, with your passkey; one per line.
help.indexerName: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (64 at most): it is the indexer identifier in sourceOrder.
help.indexerUrl: Torznab feed of the indexer, for example https://prowlarr.example.com:9696/7/api, without key or query.
help.indexerApiKey: API key of Prowlarr or of the indexer; it is sealed in the database.
help.indexerTracker: Optional: the tracker name as the library provider writes it.
help.prowlarr: Optional: Prowlarr API address with ?apikey=…, read only by the diagnostic, never used to search.
